construct.claim: Exact violated-cut separation has a fractional-image rank bound and is polynomial at half-integral points.

construct.derivation: Matching integral coordinates is necessary; projected augmented span retains provenance; at half-integral points test only zero/unit supports.

alternative.scope: Explicit undirected simple graph and fundamental-cycle basis, rational points.
alternative.derivation: Lift parity labels to two sheets; odd Eulerian subset decomposes to a violating cycle; short odd walk cannot use an odd backtrack of weight D.
